232-678-3899.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1879-4770-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

955-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5042-5567-6495--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5042-5567-6495--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4550-5042-5567-6495--112.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-527-1753-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1753-4247.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2034-4153--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4153--5--195.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

851-4826-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

997-2073-7877-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Voyager Glidecar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-7175.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1594-1739-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

997-3081-3817-7772.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1494-5014-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2757-3711-4222.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

2741-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

586-2292-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-2653-4826-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1734-6132-6797.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

339-647-677-2511.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

945-1303-4050.description:
Cast Relentless Dead by paying {B}{B}.
When Relentless Dead enters the battlefield, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Relentless Dead, adding {1}.
When Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger. Choose not to pay for either.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token Relentless Dead, adding {1}.
When the token Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {2} to return Relentless Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-5223-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1636-3143-4500-5696.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4500-5696.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

117-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
117-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control.
Talrand's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

50-52-2060-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Vedalken Certarch does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Vedalken Certarch.
You control at least three artifacts.
An opponent controls an untapped creature.
50-52-2060-4222.description:
Activate Vedalken Certarch by tapping it, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Solitary Sactuary triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Vedalken Certarch.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

2068-2173-3911.notablePrerequisites:
Each opponent's life total is no greater than 40.
You control at least 18 other nonland permanents.
2068-2173-3911.description:
Activate Bolas's Citadel by tapping it and sacrificing ten other nonland permanents you control.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bolas's Citadel's ability.
Resolve both Bolas's Citadel abilities, causing each opponent to lose 20 life.
Each opponent that had 20 or less life loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
Activate Galvanic Key by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Bolas's Citadel.
Activate Bolas's Citadel by tapping it and sacrificing itself, Manifold Key, and eight other nonland permanents you control.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bolas's Citadel's ability.
Resolve both Bolas's Citadel abilities, causing each opponent to lose 20 life.
Each remaining opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1295-1368-1778-3698.notablePrerequisites: You have four or more cards in your graveyard.
1295-1368-1778-3698.description:
Cast Underworld Breach.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite, milling yourself for three.
Cast Memnite by exiling three cards from your graveyard that are not Thassa's Oracle.
Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat steps 2 to 4 until you have no cards in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle.
Thassa's Oracle triggers, winning you the game.

618-1309-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets with haste.
The token copy of Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1267-3632-3745.notablePrerequisites:
Identity Thief does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill Identity Thief.
1267-3632-3745.description:
Declare Identity Thief as an attacker.
Identity Thief triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless, becoming a copy of it until end of turn and Return Medomai from exile to the battlefield at end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Identity Thief, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Identity Thief from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Identity Thief by paying {2}{U}{U}.
At the beginning of your end step, Identity Thief triggers, returning Medomai from exile to the battlefield.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
